title: Signal Pulse — weekly serving + console agenda (scratch)
content:
Signal Pulse — weekly serving + console agenda (scratch)
Owner: Lucy Hsu (notes scratchpad)
Week of: 2026-03-15 meeting prep (sync on 2026-03-16)
Attendees (TBD): Ravi, Maya, Omar, Arjun (SRE), Priya (Console), Tyler (Release eng)
Location: Zoom / #runtime-bridge
Meeting length target: 45m (three 12m blocks + 9m buffer)

Goals for this week's sync:
- Quick health check and any showstopper alerts that need immediate cross-team action.
- Decide on fallback policy change for small-model cold-start (INF-1243).
- Review console rollout telemetry (new DMS panel) and decide if we revert the chart changes.
- Action alignment on latency SLO experiment (15% tail reduction target by next release).

Agenda (timeboxed):
1) 0-12m: Ops pulse & critical interrupts (Ravi)
   - Today's top metrics: p50/p95/p99 tail for small/med/long sequences. Quick numbers to call out: p99-small = ~120ms (up 18% last 48h), tok/sec throughput within expected.
   - Active incidents: none rising to Sev2+, but spike observed in us-west-2 kernel queue at 03:00 UTC (investigating).
   - Action quick wins: increase kernel pre-warm for small models (temp config flag) — owner: Ravi (action 1).

2) 12-24m: Fallback routing & capacity plan (Omar)
   - Proposal: tighten policy so that hosted API falls back to quantized-variant after 150ms queue time (vs current 250ms). Rationale: reduce overall P99 for customers on free-tier.
   - Risks: potential degradation for long-context workloads; need canary on Dedicated before global flip.
   - RFC tickets: INF-1243 (fallback tuning), perf-tests: perf/fallback-2026-03.
   - Decision needed: approve canary on dedicated pool this week?

3) 24-36m: Console telemetry & rollout review (Priya/Maya)
   - New DMS panel added: per-route token-cost waterfall + per-token latency histogram. Initial feedback: looks noisy for high-traffic customers.
   - Suggestion: add sampling and 95/99 buckets instead of raw hist distribution.
   - Data ask: Maya to surface top 5 customers impacted by dashboard noise for possible targeted smoothing.

4) 36-45m: Retro quick hits + next actions (Lucy)
   - 3 quick retro bullets from last week (what worked / what blocked)
   - Decide owners & due dates for action items, confirm next checkpoint in two weeks for latency SLO experiment.

Parking lot / topics for async follow-up:
- KV-cache eviction policy change: need benchmark matrix (Arjun to own).
- Hot-shard mitigation playbook: draft exists but needs testing on staging.
- Console query performance: longer investigation, move to product/console sync.

Draft action items (to bring to meeting, then convert to JIRA):
- Action 1: Temporarily increase small-model kernel pre-warm threshold to reduce cold-start P99 spikes. Owner: Ravi. ETA: 2026-03-17. Link: JIRA INF-1301 (TBD).
- Action 2: Start a canary run of the tighter fallback policy on a dedicated pool for 48 hours. Owner: Omar. ETA: start 2026-03-17, report 2026-03-19. Linked: INF-1243.
- Action 3: Add sampling + 95/99 buckets to DMS panel and push new config to staging. Owner: Maya. ETA: 2026-03-18.
- Action 4: Compile list of top-5 noisy-dashboard customers and sample traces. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-03-18.
- Action 5: Run KV-eviction microbenchmarks with three workload shapes and summarize. Owner: Arjun. ETA: 2026-03-20.

Unresolved questions / decisions to surface in meeting:
- Is the risk profile acceptable to tighten fallback threshold now, or should we gate behind more perf-tests?
- Do we want a short-lived UI toggle for the dashboard sampling to enable/disable per-customer?

Notes to self (things to remember while running the meeting):
- Call out cost impact of fallback policy change (estimate +3% token-cost for long-context customers) — have back-of-envelope.
- If approval for canary is given, request dedicated pool capacity from platform-eng (Tyler).
- Be explicit about rollback criteria for the console panel change (errors / >5% false-positives in anomalies).

Quick links / prep artifacts to share before the meeting:
- Perf dashboard (latest 72h): https://internal.redwood/dashboards/serving/perf-72h
- INF-1243 (jira): https://jira.internal.redwood/browse/INF-1243
- PR for DMS panel changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/842

Follow-ups after meeting (template I'll paste into JIRA / slack):
- Summary (1 paragraph), decisions (bullet), owners + ETA (bullet), next checkpoint date (two weeks)

Next checkpoint: 2026-03-30 (two-week sync on latency SLO experiment status)

Scratchpad thoughts (freeform):
- If we can shave 10% off small-model p99 with pre-warm + fallback combo, that materially improves perceived latency for demos. Worth tradeoff even if token-cost slightly increases.
- Consider a short customer-facing note if we roll fallback — set expectations for long-context customers.
- For the console change, think about deferred rendering and client-side aggregation to reduce noise upfront.

End of scratchpad.

(Will convert to a tidy agenda doc and push to shared bridge channel once we have attendees confirmed.)
